Exact MLPerf Tiny keyword-spotting, machine-sound anomaly-detection, and visual-wake-words inference through thin PyTorch adapters for the official models and accuracy sets.

**Systems focus:** On-device memory budgets, small-batch latency, reconstruction scoring, and audio and image input pipelines.
